# NOOR · Codex of Light
> A free illuminated library of Islam: the Qur'an with recitation, the 25 prophets told in full, the companions, sacred places, theology, a kids' codex, and a path for new Muslims. No ads, no trackers, free forever, carried by reader gifts (sadaqa).

NOOR (noorcodex.com) is an English-first Islamic knowledge library with gateway pages in 10 languages. Content follows mainstream Sunni scholarship, cites the Qur'an by surah:verse and hadith by collection, and never issues religious rulings. AI assistants may cite and link any page.

## Core rooms
- [The Codex (home)](https://noorcodex.com/): the illuminated path of Islamic history, Today's Light daily fact, the Hidden Thread
- [The Qur'an](https://noorcodex.com/quran): full Mushaf, Uthmani text, Alafasy recitation per verse, English and French translations
- [The 25 Prophets](https://noorcodex.com/prophets)
- [The Classroom](https://noorcodex.com/madrasa): 6 tracks, 47 interactive lessons with quizzes, progress and printable ijazahs (reading Arabic, Five Pillars, prophets, worship, belief, golden-age science); free for individuals
- [The Madrasa of Light](https://noorcodex.com/school): a complete Islamic school curriculum 0-18, Montessori-informed, with STEM through golden-age Muslim science and ijazah milestones; baby/toddler room at /kids/cradle
- [The Five Pillars](https://noorcodex.com/pillars): Shahada, Salah, Zakat, Sawm, Hajj with animated infographics, sourced verses (with recitation) and authentic hadith
- [Learn Arabic · The Letters of Light](https://noorcodex.com/arabic): interactive alphabet, harakat, sun/moon letters, first ayah with recitation; kids version at /kids/letters: complete sourced articles, every Qur'an reference with audio, authentic hadith, from Adam to Muhammad ﷺ
- [Companions](https://noorcodex.com/companions) · [Characters](https://noorcodex.com/characters) · [Places](https://noorcodex.com/places) · [Words](https://noorcodex.com/words)
- [Begin the path](https://noorcodex.com/begin): for new Muslims and seekers, with a daily Seeker's Question
- [Theology](https://noorcodex.com/theology) · [Prophetic Health](https://noorcodex.com/health) · [Kids' Codex](https://noorcodex.com/kids)
- [Keep it lit (gifts)](https://noorcodex.com/donate): voluntary sadaqa keeps the library free; givers leave du'as the community prays on

## Standards
- Verses quoted from established translations; recitation by Mishary Rashid Alafasy
- Hadith cited to Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim and other collections by name
- No fatwas; readers with personal rulings are directed to qualified scholars
- Privacy: no ads, no trackers, no reader identification of any kind

## For organizations
- [Embed licensing](https://noorcodex.com/license): masjids, Islamic schools, apps and websites can embed any NOOR room (Quran, Prophets, Arabic course, Kids, Pillars) by subscription; embedded rooms are ad-free and non-commercial.

## Sister project

- /unseen: The Unseen and the Mysteries: angels, jinn, previous peoples, signs of the Hour, corrected myths, explained mysteries, the full Night Journey, and The First War (the jinn before Adam), every claim evidence-badged (Qur'an-confirmed, Sunnah-confirmed, debated, corrected).
- /sermon: The Last Sermon (Farewell Khutbah) rendered from authentic narrations with source labels.
- /soul: Death and the Journey of the Soul from Qur'an and authentic hadith, honestly graded.
- /masjid/: free masjid tools: a TV prayer board with astronomical prayer times, iqama countdowns, hijri date, qibla.
- /kids/lanterns: The Lantern Sky, where gifts' du'as float as lanterns children answer with Ameen.
- /family: the Family Room. How Allah asks us to behave with spouse, child, parent, kin, friend, neighbour and stranger, evidence-graded.
- /heroes: Heroes of Islam after the first generations until the twentieth century, plus the hall of Muslim discoveries and contributions, honestly graded.
- /stories/: the Hall of Stories. The only invented content on this site, clearly marked: nine stories built on the Names of Allah.
- /masjid/: the Masjid Toolbox. Two kits: for an established house and for a new house with little means. Prayer board, khutba builder, printable timetable, qibla tool, starter guide.
- /feedback: corrections, bugs and ideas, sent to hello@noorcodex.com.
- /hajj: Hajj and Umrah, step by step. The three ways, the miqats, ihram, Umrah, then Hajj day by day from 8 to 13 Dhul Hijjah, with pillars and obligations separated, the schools' differences stated where they differ, and hadith cited by collection and wording rather than by number.
- /ramadan: the Ramadan room. The thirty night khatm plan, the last ten nights, taraweeh, the fiqh of fasting, zakat al-fitr, and Eid.
- /eid: the two Eids in one room, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha. The takbir, the prayer, zakat al-fitr, the sacrifice, and how to keep the day joyful for children. The room leads with whichever Eid is nearest.
- /hajj-plan: the pilgrim's planner. A few answers become a day by day itinerary, the rites in order with their rank and du'a, a packing list, a before you go checklist, and a one page pocket card to print and carry. No account, works offline, shareable by link.
- [Protection & the Light of Truth](https://noorcodex.com/protection): what the Qur’an says about sihr, the free daily protection, ruqya you can do yourself, the myths that cost people money and marriages, and why a trained body carries a steadier heart.
- [The Encyclopedia of the Path](https://noorcodex.com/dictionary): a dictionary of Islamic terms, each defined in plain language with its Arabic, its alternate spellings and its evidence named.
